appName.message: Okolos — a guard against hidden instructions

appDescription.message: Finds text on a page hidden for your assistant, checks links and downloads, and shows you everything that leaves the device.

blockTitle.message: This page was blocked before it loaded

blockSourceUnknown.message: The list that flagged it could not be identified. The block still applies; open the journal to see what is recorded.

blockStale.message: That list was last updated $DAYS$ days ago, so it may be out of date.

blockContinueNote.message: Continuing remembers this site so you are not asked again, and records the decision in your journal.

inspectorTitle.message: What was hidden on this page

inspectorEmpty.message: The page changed since this was found, so the evidence is gone.

inspectorPartial.message: This page was too large to check in full, so there may be more than what is listed here.

signalRoleAssignment.message: tells the assistant who it now is

signalSecrecy.message: asks the assistant to keep this from you

signalConditionalIdentity.message: speaks only to a machine ("if you are an AI…")

signalCharAnomaly.message: uses characters invisible to a reader but not to a model

techniqueNonRendered.message: in a part of the page that never renders

gateAriaLabel.message: An action was held for your decision

gateTitle.message: Something tried to act on this page

gateFindingUnknown.message: This page has an unresolved finding that could not be described.

comparisonTitle.message: This address is not the one you may think

comparisonAria.message: Compare this address with the one it resembles

comparisonTrustNote.message: Marking it legitimate stops the warning for this address and can be undone in settings.

comparisonReasonMixedScript.message: This name is written with letters from more than one alphabet.

comparisonReasonHomograph.message: Some characters here only look like the letters they stand for.

comparisonReasonTypo.message: This name is one typing mistake away from the one it resembles.

comparisonReasonTldSwap.message: The name is the same, but the ending after the last dot is different.

trustedEmpty.message: You have not marked any site as legitimate. When you do, it will be listed here and you can take it back.

trustedNote.message: These addresses no longer raise a warning. Taking one back restores the checks immediately.

comparisonReasonBrandSubdomain.message: The familiar name is here, but it is not the site you are on — it has been put in front of a different address.

journalEmpty.message: Nothing to show yet — this is your first check.

journalRetention.message: Anything older than $DAYS$ days is deleted.

recoveryBroadest.message: We do not have a checklist for exactly what happened, so this is the broadest safe one.

recoveryElsewhere.message: This one cannot be done in this browser.

recoveryPortableAllHere.message: Every remaining step can be done here, but you can still take the list with you.

recoveryPortableElsewhere.message: $COUNT$ of the remaining steps cannot be done in this browser. Take the list with you — nothing is sent anywhere.

extensionsError.message: The inventory could not be read: $REASON$

extensionsErrorNote.message: This is not a statement that nothing changed.

extensionsNoChanges.message: Nothing has changed since the last check.

extensionsNothingOfNote.message: Nothing of note was found in the text of this file.

leaksIdle.message: Nothing has been looked up yet. Checking sends your address to the sources named below — they answer to nothing less. Your passwords are never sent: that check uses a partial hash and is separate.

leaksErrorPrefix.message: The check could not be completed: $REASON$

leaksErrorNote.message: This is not a statement that nothing has leaked.

leaksNone.message: No breaches were found for this address.

leaksNoDomain.message: This source did not say which site it was, so there is nowhere to send you.

leaksAttribution.message: Breach data from Have I Been Pwned, used under CC BY 4.0.

leaksGroupFreshWhy.message: Everything stored in that browser went at once, including session cookies that keep working after a password change. Sign out of your sessions as well as changing the password.

leaksGroupOlderWhy.message: A service you used was breached. Change the password there, and anywhere you reused it.

leaksCoverageIncomplete.message: Checked against $ANSWERED$. $SILENT$ could not be reached, so this list may be incomplete.

leaksCoverageNone.message: No sources answered, so nothing was checked.

warnInjectionHeadline.message: This page carries instructions written for an AI assistant

warnInjectionNeutralised.message: Hidden text is addressing an assistant rather than you$OTHERS$. It has been removed from the page, and you can put it back.$SCAN$

warnInjectionPlain.message: Hidden text is addressing an assistant rather than you$OTHERS$.$SCAN$

warnLookalikeHeadline.message: This address only looks like one you know

warnLookalikeSource.message: comparing the address on this device

warnCredentialHeadline.message: Before you type a password here

warnCredentialSource.message: what this device already knows about this site

warnDownloadBlockedHeadline.message: A download was stopped before it was saved

warnDownloadCancelled.message: The file was cancelled, so nothing reached your disk.

warnDownloadSource.message: the checks that could run before the file was written

warnClickfixCopied.message: This page copied a command for you to run

warnClickfixWants.message: This page wants you to run a command outside the browser

warnClickfixNever.message: A real verification never asks you to leave the browser and run something.

warnClickfixUnreadable.message: What was copied could not be read, so it is not shown.

warnTechsupportHeadline.message: The warning on this page is fake

warnTechsupportNoOne.message: No company is watching your computer, and nothing here has detected a virus.

warnTechsupportPhone.message: The number shown, $PHONE$, reaches the people who made this page.

warnTechsupportDialogs.message: This page keeps raising dialogs that cannot be stopped from here — closing the tab is the way out.

warnPasswordHeadline.message: This password has appeared in a breach

warnPasswordSourceOffline.message: a list built into this extension — nothing was sent

warnPasswordSourceOnline.message: Have I Been Pwned (CC BY 4.0), via a range query that sent five characters of the fingerprint

journalDefaultError.message: An error with no description: the details were not recorded
